Name: Utility Belt
Author: ModderDrew
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a utility belt for quick use of many items.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]As an extension of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27666]Utility Pocket[/url], this mod adds the ability to have multiple pockets at once![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Most/all mod configuration should be done through GMCM.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Drag and drop folder from zip file into SMAPI mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiple quick-use pockets [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Story mode capability (can buy pockets) [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]HUD Options (Generic Mod Config Menu HEAVILY recommended)[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Caution[/size][/b]
As with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27666]Utility Pocket[/url], PLEASE MAKE SURE TO REMOVE POCKETED ITEMS BEFORE UNINSTALLING THE MOD.

If you accidentally uninstall, you can reinstall the mod and you should maintain the items inside the pockets.

[size=4][b]Planned Features / Feedback[/b][/size]
Please let me know if there's anything you'd like added/adjusted in this mod. I am planning on adding a few more features, but would like to hear some feedback so I know which features would be most utilized.

[size=3][b]Planned features[/b][/size]:
[list]
[*]Easier way to bind pockets: Thinking something along the lines of what the SDV toolbar does (scroll to the pocket you want to place the toolbar item in) so you don't have to bind pocket keys to every pocket (would probably make the mod controller friendly)[/*]
[*]More location options: Thinking lower left corner as the original Utility Pocket was, but have to figure out spacing.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support: Honestly haven't tested this mod in multiplayer but am up for fully testing it and ensuring it works.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Notes[/size][/b]
As I only speak English, translations were generated with AI. Some translated phrases may sound unnatural or may be incorrect. Please report any corrections as well as any bugs and I’ll address them.
